metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: AuditEvent ASIM filtering parser for Salesforce Audit Trail
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    actorusername_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    operation_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventtype_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventresult: string = "*",
    object_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    newvalue_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    let SectionObjectTypeLookup = datatable(
        Section: string,
        ObjectTypeFromSection: string
    )[
        // Directory service objects
        "Customize Service Resources", "Directory Service Object",
        "Customize Users", "Directory Service Object",
        "Department to Roles", "Directory Service Object",
        "Experiences network Member Group", "Directory Service Object",
        "Groupe d'ensembles d'autorisations", "Directory Service Object",
        "Groupes", "Directory Service Object",
        "Groups", "Directory Service Object",
        "G\u00e9rer les utilisateurs", "Directory Service Object",
        "Manage Users", "Directory Service Object",
        "OAuth Client Credentials User", "Directory Service Object",
        "Permission Set Group", "Directory Service Object",
        "Personnaliser les utilisateurs", "Directory Service Object",
        "Profiles", "Directory Service Object",
        "Teams", "Directory Service Object",
        "User Permission Mappings", "Directory Service Object",
        // Policy rules
        "Approval Process", "Policy Rule",
        "Bypass Rules Configurations", "Policy Rule",
        "Cancellation Approval Rules", "Policy Rule",
        "Case Allocation To Queues", "Policy Rule",
        "Case Closure Email Rules", "Policy Rule",
        "Connected App Session Policy", "Policy Rule",
        "Custom Permissions", "Policy Rule",
        "Data Integration Rule", "Policy Rule",
        "Duplicate Rule", "Policy Rule",
        "eHS Naming and SSID Rules", "Policy Rule",
        "Field Dependencies", "Policy Rule",
        "Key Attachment Document Rules", "Policy Rule",
        "Keyword Routing Rules", "Policy Rule",
        "Matching Rule", "Policy Rule",
        "Password Policies", "Policy Rule",
        "Portal Case Visibility", "Policy Rule",
        "Routing Exclusions", "Policy Rule",
        "R\u00e8gles de partage", "Policy Rule",
        "Security Controls", "Policy Rule",
        "Session Settings", "Policy Rule",
        "Sharing Defaults", "Policy Rule",
        "Sharing Rules", "Policy Rule",
        "Sharing Sets", "Policy Rule",
        "Transaction Security", "Policy Rule",
        "User Access Configurations", "Policy Rule",
        "Validation Rules", "Policy Rule",
        "Workflow Rule", "Policy Rule",
        // Event logs
        "Customize Historical Entity Trending", "Event Log",
        "Customize Historical Field Trending", "Event Log",
        "Entity History", "Event Log",
        "Feed Tracking", "Event Log",
        "Suivre l'historique des champs", "Event Log",
        "Track Field History", "Event Log",
        // Scheduled tasks
        "Customer Journey Tasks", "Scheduled Task",
        "Data Export", "Scheduled Task",
        "Duplicate Jobs", "Scheduled Task",
        // Services
        "Application", "Service",
        "Application cliente externe", "Service",
        "Applications Inbox mobiles et pour le bureau h\u00e9rit\u00e9es", "Service",
        "Applications personnalis\u00e9es", "Service",
        "Auth Providers", "Service",
        "Call Centers", "Service",
        "Change Data Capture", "Service",
        "Connected Apps", "Service",
        "Custom Apps", "Service",
        "Customer Portal", "Service",
        "Event Bus Relay", "Service",
        "Event Manager", "Service",
        "External Client Application", "Service",
        "Identity Provider", "Service",
        "Inbox mobile and legacy desktop apps", "Service",
        "Omni-Channel", "Service",
        "Partner Relationship Management", "Service",
        "Portail client", "Service",
        "Remote Access", "Service",
        "Salesforce Voice", "Service",
        "SIS SF Teacher Integrations", "Service",
        "Third Party Check Service Messages", "Service",
        // Cloud resources
        "Certificate and Key Management", "Cloud Resource",
        "Custom Objects", "Cloud Resource",
        "Encription Keys", "Cloud Resource",
        "External Objects", "Cloud Resource",
        "My Domain", "Cloud Resource",
        "Objets personnalis\u00e9s", "Cloud Resource",
        "PowerBI Reports", "Cloud Resource",
        "Private Connections", "Cloud Resource",
        "Ressources statiques", "Cloud Resource",
        "Sandbox", "Cloud Resource",
        "Sandboxes", "Cloud Resource",
        "Second Generation Package Version", "Cloud Resource",
        "Sites", "Cloud Resource",
        "Static Resource", "Cloud Resource"
    ];
    let directory_object_action_regex = @"(^permset|permissionsetgroup|setupentityaccessaudit_(permissionset|profile)|^profile|^createduser|^deleteduser|^activateduser|^deactivateduser|^frozeuser|^unfrozeuser|^unlockeduser|^changed(username|email|password|profile|role)|^resetpassword$|^group(member|membership)|^queue(member|membership)|^team_|^tm2_user)";
    let policy_rule_action_regex = @"(rule|policy|sharing)|^(changedvalidation|newvalidation|removedvalidation|password(complexity|expiry|lockout|maxinvalid)|sessiontimeout|locksessiondomain|updatesessionsecuritylevel|loginiprange)";
    let event_log_action_regex = @"(historytrack|historytracking|entity_history|historicaltrending|feed_field_tracked)";
    let scheduled_task_action_regex = @"^(bulkjobactions|createbulkjobdefinition|datacategorybatchcomplete)$";
    let cloud_resource_action_regex = @"^(deletesandbox|discardsandbox|sandboxlicensematch(success)?|archivedmasterencryptionkey|changedstaticresource|createnewsalesforcesite|createdstaticresource|deletescratchorg|deletedstaticresource|insertcertificate)$";
    let service_action_regex = @"(application|connectedapp|ecapp|authprovider|callcenter|credential|oauth|saml|idp|servicechannel|presenceuserconfig|queuerouting|privateconnection|remoteproxy|packagingapp|loginflow)";
    SalesforceAuditTrail
    | where not(disabled)
    | where isnull(starttime)
        or CreatedDate >= starttime
        or (isnull(CreatedDate) and TimeGenerated >= starttime)
    | where isnull(endtime)
        or CreatedDate <= endtime
        or (isnull(CreatedDate) and TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | extend ActorUsername = coalesce(
        CreatedByUsername,
        CreatedByEmail,
        CreatedByName)
    | where array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0
        or ActorUsername has_any (actorusername_has_any)
    | extend
        Operation = coalesce(Action, Display, "Salesforce audit event"),
        Object = coalesce(Section, Action, "Salesforce configuration")
    | where array_length(operation_has_any) == 0
        or Operation has_any (operation_has_any)
    | where array_length(object_has_any) == 0
        or Object has_any (object_has_any)
    | lookup SectionObjectTypeLookup on Section
    | extend ActionKey = tolower(Action)
    | extend ObjectType = case(
        isnotempty(ObjectTypeFromSection), ObjectTypeFromSection,
        isnotempty(Section), "Configuration Atom",
        ActionKey matches regex directory_object_action_regex,
            "Directory Service Object",
        ActionKey matches regex policy_rule_action_regex,
            "Policy Rule",
        ActionKey matches regex event_log_action_regex,
            "Event Log",
        ActionKey matches regex scheduled_task_action_regex,
            "Scheduled Task",
        ActionKey matches regex cloud_resource_action_regex,
            "Cloud Resource",
        ActionKey matches regex service_action_regex,
            "Service",
        "Configuration Atom")
    // This parser does not support srcipaddr_has_any_prefix filtering.
    // Intentionally fail closed: any non-empty srcipaddr_has_any_prefix input returns 0 rows.
    | where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
    | where eventresult == "*"
        or eventresult =~ "Success"
    | extend EventType = case(
        Action has_any ("created", "added", "inserted", "provisioned")
            or Display has_any ("created", "added", "inserted", "provisioned"), "Create",
        Action has_any ("deleted", "removed", "deprovisioned")
            or Display has_any ("deleted", "removed", "deprovisioned"), "Delete",
        Action has_any ("enabled", "activated", "unfrozen")
            or Display has_any ("enabled", "activated", "unfrozen"), "Enable",
        Action has_any ("disabled", "deactivated", "frozen")
            or Display has_any ("disabled", "deactivated", "frozen"), "Disable",
        Action has_any ("installed", "upgraded")
            or Display has_any ("installed", "upgraded"), "Install",
        Action has_any ("initialized", "initialised")
            or Display has_any ("initialized", "initialised"), "Initialize",
        Action has_any ("started", "launched")
            or Display has_any ("started", "launched"), "Start",
        Action has_any ("stopped", "paused")
            or Display has_any ("stopped", "paused"), "Stop",
        Action has_any ("terminated", "killed")
            or Display has_any ("terminated", "killed"), "Terminate",
        Action has_any ("cleared", "reset", "purged")
            or Display has_any ("cleared", "reset", "purged"), "Clear",
        Action has_any ("executed", "invoked", "ran")
            or Display has_any ("executed", "invoked", "ran"), "Execute",
        Action has_any ("viewed", "read", "downloaded", "exported")
            or Display has_any ("viewed", "read", "downloaded", "exported"), "Read",
        "Set")
    | where array_length(eventtype_in) == 0
        or EventType in~ (eventtype_in)
    | parse Display with * " from " ParsedOldValue: string " to " ParsedNewValue: string
    | parse Display with CreatedValue: string " was created"
    | parse Display with DeletedValue: string " was deleted"
    | parse Display with * " assigned to " AssignedValue: string
    | parse Display with * " removed from " RemovedValue: string
    | extend
        OldValue = case(
            isnotempty(ParsedOldValue),
                trim(@"\s+", ParsedOldValue),
            Action startswith "deactivated"
                or Display contains " was deactivated",
                "Active",
            Action startswith "activated"
                or Display contains " was activated",
                "Inactive",
            Action startswith "disable"
                or Action endswith "Disabled"
                or Display contains " was disabled",
                "Enabled",
            Action startswith "enable"
                or Action endswith "Enabled"
                or Display contains " was enabled",
                "Disabled",
            Action startswith "unfroze"
                or Action contains "Unfreeze"
                or Display contains " was unfrozen",
                "Frozen",
            Action startswith "froze"
                or Action contains "Freeze"
                or Display contains " was frozen",
                "Unfrozen",
            isnotempty(DeletedValue),
                trim(@"\s+", DeletedValue),
            isnotempty(RemovedValue),
                trim(@"\s+", RemovedValue),
            ""),
        NewValue = case(
            isnotempty(ParsedNewValue),
                trim(@"\s+", ParsedNewValue),
            Action startswith "deactivated"
                or Display contains " was deactivated",
                "Inactive",
            Action startswith "activated"
                or Display contains " was activated",
                "Active",
            Action startswith "disable"
                or Action endswith "Disabled"
                or Display contains " was disabled",
                "Disabled",
            Action startswith "enable"
                or Action endswith "Enabled"
                or Display contains " was enabled",
                "Enabled",
            Action startswith "unfroze"
                or Action contains "Unfreeze"
                or Display contains " was unfrozen",
                "Unfrozen",
            Action startswith "froze"
                or Action contains "Freeze"
                or Display contains " was frozen",
                "Frozen",
            isnotempty(CreatedValue),
                trim(@"\s+", CreatedValue),
            isnotempty(AssignedValue),
                trim(@"\s+", AssignedValue),
            "")
    | where array_length(newvalue_has_any) == 0
        or NewValue has_any (newvalue_has_any)
    | extend EventTime = coalesce(CreatedDate, TimeGenerated)
    | invoke _ASIM_ResolveFQDN('SalesforceDomain')
    | extend
        EventUid = coalesce(
            Id,
            hash_sha256(strcat(
                TenantId, "|",
                tostring(EventTime), "|",
                CreatedById, "|",
                Action, "|",
                Section, "|",
                Display))),
        ActorUsernameType = _ASIM_GetUsernameType(ActorUsername),
        ActorUserType = case(
            CreatedByContext =~ "User", "Regular",
            isempty(CreatedByContext), "",
            "Other"),
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack,
            bag_pack(
                "CreatedByIssuer", CreatedByIssuer,
                "CreatedByName", CreatedByName,
                "DelegateUser", DelegateUser,
                "SourceSystem", SourceSystem,
                "CreatedDate", CreatedDate,
                "TenantId", TenantId
            ),
            dynamic({}))
    | project-rename
        ActorOriginalUserType = CreatedByContext,
        ActorUserId = CreatedById,
        ActorUserUpn = CreatedByEmail,
        EventOriginalUid = Id
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Type = "SalesforceAuditTrail",
        EventCount = toint(1),
        EventEndTime = EventTime,
        EventMessage = Display,
        EventOriginalSubType = Section,
        EventOriginalType = Action,
        EventOriginalUid,
        EventProduct = "Salesforce Audit Trail",
        EventResult = "Success",
        EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventStartTime = EventTime,
        EventSubType = Section,
        EventType,
        EventUid,
        EventVendor = "Salesforce",
        ActorOriginalUserType,
        ActorUserId,
        ActorUserIdType = iff(
            isnotempty(ActorUserId),
            "SalesforceId",
            ""),
        ActorUsername,
        ActorUsernameType,
        ActorUserType,
        ActorUserUpn,
        AdditionalFields,
        Dst = coalesce(FQDN, tostring(ExtractedHostname)),
        Dvc = "Salesforce Audit Trail",
        NewValue,
        Object,
        ObjectType,
        OldValue,
        Operation,
        OriginalObjectType = Section,
        TargetDescription = Display,
        TargetDomain = tostring(Domain),
        TargetDomainType = DomainType,
        TargetFQDN = FQDN,
        TargetHostname = tostring(ExtractedHostname),
        TargetUrl = iff(
            isnotempty(SalesforceDomain),
            strcat("https://", SalesforceDomain),
            ""),
        User = ActorUsername,
        Value = NewValue
};
parser(
    starttime=starttime,
    endtime=endtime,
    srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    actorusername_has_any=actorusername_has_any,
    operation_has_any=operation_has_any,
    eventtype_in=eventtype_in,
    eventresult=eventresult,
    object_has_any=object_has_any,
    newvalue_has_any=newvalue_has_any,
    disabled=disabled,
    pack=pack
)
